svg.title: macOS · Settings · library location · move confirm · 760×680
svg.desc: Mirrors App/SettingsView.swift (libraryLocationRows + StorageLocationSheet) over App/StorageLocation.swift (StorageRoot, StorageMover) — macOS ONLY, the whole feature is #if os(macOS): iOS storage is the sandbox and has nowhere else to be. THE ROWS (drawn on the backdrop, mid-Storage-card between the byte figures and "Review large originals"): "Library location" shows the CURRENT resolved root ~-abbreviated with a state-carrying subtitle — on the default it invites nominating another drive; on a custom root it is just the path; when the nominated root was unreachable at launch it says so and how to get back. Its Change… button (bordered, like the card's other buttons; disabled while model.stage == .processing — never move the floor under a running render) opens a folder picker (.fileImporter, UTType.folder). A second accent row appears only off-default: "Move back to the default location" (same flow, destination = default), replaced by "Keep using the default location" when the launch fell back — that one just clears the setting (StorageRoot.forgetCustomPath), because the session already runs on the default. WHAT A PICK MEANS is decided before anything is offered (StorageRoot.check): alreadyCurrent / insideCurrent / notWritable (a REAL write probe — POSIX bits don't answer for a read-only mount) / collision (a same-named item that is not a library — refuse rather than merge; the alert also names interrupted-move leftovers) are plain alerts, never this sheet. A folder holding Projects/library.json offers ADOPT (variant, desc-only: title "Use this library?", primary "Switch to This Library", prose warns it may not match the current library and that the current one stays unchanged — commit + relaunch screen, no copying). An empty folder offers THE MOVE DRAWN HERE. The sheet is blocking (interactiveDismissDisabled) like the import sheet and for the same reason: the copy owns the disk. THE MOVE IS A COPY — the old library is NEVER deleted (a mover that deletes originals has to be perfect; one that doesn't only has to be honest), which the prose says outright. It carries the known top-level items only (Projects, Collections, Thumbnails, CaptureLogs, Logs, blend-profiles.json, custom_presets.json — StorageRoot.libraryItemNames), so nominating a drive's own root never drags unrelated folders along on a later move back; hidden files are skipped. Free space is checked against the walked byte total (+1 GB) before the first copy; cancel and failure remove exactly the top-level items the move created. The "about 148,2 GB" figure is Settings' own walked originals+clips total (cache lives in temp and stays behind). ON SUCCESS the mover commits the path (UserDefaults "storage.libraryRootPath"; choosing the default CLEARS the key) and the sheet flips to the relaunch screen (variant, desc-only: externaldrive.fill.badge.checkmark, title "Relaunch to finish", prose "anything new still lands at the previous location" + delete-the-old-copy-in-Finder guidance, primary "Relaunch LetsLapse" — which DISMISSES THE SHEET FIRST and terminates 0.4 s later, because NSApp.terminate sent while a sheet is presented is silently swallowed (found in the field 2026-08-25: the press spawned the relaunch helper and the app just stayed up; reproduced via AX press, fixed same day) — AppRelaunch spawns a shell that waits for this pid to exit before `open`ing the bundle so the new instance can't race the single-window scene, and exits hard after 1.5 s if terminate is still refused — secondary "Not Yet"). FAILURE (desc-only: red exclamationmark.triangle.fill, "Couldn't move the library", reason, Close) covers the free-space refusal and per-file copy errors. THE LOCATION APPLIES ON RELAUNCH by design: `StorageRoot.current` resolves ONCE per process because AppModel's loaded library and the two path-latching singletons (CustomPresetStore, BlendProfileStore) cannot survive a mid-session root swap. A nominated root unreachable at launch (drive unplugged) falls back to the default for the session, KEEPS the setting, and says so in a launch alert (LetsLapseApp, macOS block) plus the row subtitle. Screenshot hooks: LL_TAB=settings LL_STORAGE=move|adopt|moving|done|failed stage this sheet with demo values, nothing on disk touched. Progress variant drawn in settings-library-location.moving.svg. Verified against the running Mac app 2026-08-25 (all five staged states + the real card with the library's true 140,47 GB / 22,41 GB free figures); the copy engine itself proven by a standalone harness over the real StorageLocation.swift (move, adopt detection, collision, read-only refusal, unreachable-root fallback).

g.text: ~/Library/Application Support/LetsLapse — the default. Nominate a folder on another drive to keep the library there instead.
Adds an extra rate to capture's frame-rate options whenever the camera supports it
What Psycho intervals have taught Safe mode on this device
Your library — about 148,2 GB of projects,
thumbnails and capture logs — is copied to this
folder, and LetsLapse relaunches to use it there.
Nothing is deleted: the current copy stays at ~/
